title: 第12章教育宁荣荣，兄弟就是用来坑的-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    叶寒俯视而下，冷漠地向跪在地面上的戴沐白威胁。

    这是他给戴沐白最后一次机会。

    只要戴沐白敢毁约，他便会直接动手，阉了他。

    连承诺都不敢遵守的人，根本就不配成为一名男人。

    “我，我愿赌服输。”

    “老大！”

    戴沐白抿了抿嘴，不甘心地向叶寒喊出违背意愿的称呼。

    以叶寒冷漠的性格，若是他不妥协，或许就真的变成太监了。

    在尊严和男儿身方面，他还是坚决选择了后者。

    叫一声老大，后面还能改变现状。

    可若是变成太监，那就真的没有机会了。

    【叮！恭喜宿主收小弟戴沐白，为家族增添成员。】

    【叮！系统绑定戴沐白成功，奖励帝王光环，获得战神（二级神祇）传承。】

    【注：帝王光环是一种强大的被动属性，天生具备帝王领域，拥有吞噬国运的作用，掌握帝王机缘，可统一世界，建立帝国。】

    【叮！恭喜宿主收到戴沐白反馈，第一枚魂环年限提升四百年，第二枚魂环提升七百年，魂力提升一级。】

    【叮！朱竹清帮宿主招揽戴沐白，贡献值15%，宿主和朱竹清皆提升1.5倍的修行速度和体魄加成。】

    “不错，还算你有点男人气概。”

    叶寒收到系统的提示，心满意足地走到宁荣荣的面前。

    此时，她就躺在朱竹清的怀里，没有苏醒的迹象。

    但叶寒刚才根本就没有太用力，掌握好了分寸。

    刚才那一击，最多让她暂时昏迷一分钟。

    显然，宁荣荣在这里装晕，不想面对现实。

    “宁荣荣，别以为我不知道你早就醒了。”

    “若是你还打算继续装晕，我不介意扒光你的衣服。”

    叶寒冷声威胁，丝毫不在乎他刚才说的话有多难听，有多影响形象。

    在他的眼里，只要能完成任务，再难听的话，再恶劣的形象，也都是好办法。

    “叶寒，你这个流氓！”

    装晕的宁荣荣被吓坏了，赶紧爬起了起来，与他保持距离。

    她生怕叶寒突然动手，把她的衣服都扒光了。

    此时此刻，她都后悔死了。

    就不应该答应戴沐白的邀请。

    否则，她现在也不至于这么被动。

    这下倒好，她该怎么办。

    “荣荣，你竟然在装晕。”

    “你太过分了。”

    “亏我刚才一直抱着你。”

    朱竹清本来对叶寒刚才无礼的话有点抵触的。

    但她一想到宁荣荣刚才在利用她装晕，惹人同情，就很生气。

    “是流氓也好，不是流氓也罢。”

    “现在该轮到你兑现承诺了。”

    叶寒可不会将宁荣荣的话放在心上，他现在只想要结果。

    先将这些人拉入家族系统，再慢慢调教。

    总有一天，他会让所有人心服口服。

    哪怕是有些人始终不服也不怕，他也不在乎一星半点的神位传承。

    甚至他有预感，向唐三和戴沐白这两种人，就不容易降服。

    如果无法降服，那就只有当成敌人来收拾了。

    或许，把他们收拾惨了，也会慢慢选择妥协，为他所用。

    “哼，我又不是男人大丈夫，我就不兑现承诺怎么了？”

    “有种你杀我啊？”

    “只要我死了，整个史莱克学院都要因你的行为陪葬。”

    宁荣荣说不出口，更不想喊老大，直接摆出一副死猪不怕开水烫的样子。

    “呵呵，既然你不兑现承诺。”

    “那就别怪我不讲情面，替你父母管教你。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Han looked down and threatened Dai Mubai who was kneeling on the ground indifferently.

This is the last chance he gives Dai Mubai.

"As long as Dai Mubai dares to break the contract, he will directly take action and castrate him.

“A person who dares not even keep his promise is not worthy of being a man at all.

"I, I am willing to admit defeat."

"Boss!"

Dai Mubai pursed his lips and reluctantly called Ye Han the name that was against his will.

With Ye Han's indifferent character, if he doesn't compromise, he might really become a eunuch.

In terms of dignity and masculinity, he still firmly chose the latter.

Just call me boss, and you can change the status quo later.

But if you become a eunuch, you really have no chance.

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for accepting his younger brother Dai Mubai and adding a new member to the family.】

【Ding!Successfully binding Dai Mubai to the system will reward him with an imperial aura and the inheritance of the God of War (second-level god).】

【Note: The emperor's aura is a powerful passive attribute. It is born with the emperor's domain and has the function of swallowing up the fate of the country. By grasping the opportunity of the emperor, it can unify the world and establish an empire.】

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for receiving feedback from Dai Mubai. The age of the first soul ring has been increased by four hundred years, the second soul ring has been increased by seven hundred years, and the soul power has been increased by one level.】

【Ding!Zhu Zhuqing helped the host recruit Dai Mubai, with a contribution of 15%. Both the host and Zhu Zhuqing increased their practice speed and physical strength by 1.5 times.】

"Not bad, you are somewhat masculine."

Ye Han received the system prompt and walked to Ning Rongrong with satisfaction.

At this time, she was lying in Zhu Zhuqing's arms, showing no signs of waking up.

But Ye Han didn't use too much force just now, he had a good grasp of the situation.

The blow just now could make her temporarily unconscious for a minute at most.

“Obviously, Ning Rongrong is pretending to be dizzy here and doesn’t want to face reality.

"Ning Rongrong, don't think that I don't know that you woke up a long time ago."

"If you still plan to pretend to be faint, I don't mind taking off your clothes."

Ye Leng threatened, not caring how ugly what he just said was and how it affected his image.

In his eyes, as long as the task can be completed, no matter how ugly the words are or how bad the image is, it is still a good idea.

"Ye Han, you gangster!"

Ning Rongrong, who was pretending to be dizzy, was frightened and quickly got up, keeping a distance from him.

She was afraid that Ye Han would suddenly take action and take off all her clothes.

At this moment, she regretted it to death.

You shouldn’t agree to Dai Mubai’s invitation.

“Otherwise, she wouldn’t be so passive now.

This is good, what should she do?

"Rongrong, you are actually pretending to be faint."

"You've gone too far."

“Thankfully I was holding you just now.”

Zhu Zhuqing was originally a little resistant to Ye Han's rude words just now.

But when she thought that Ning Rongrong had just used her to pretend to be faint and arouse sympathy, she became very angry.

"It doesn't matter if he is a gangster or not."

"Now it's your turn to fulfill your promise."

Ye Han will not take Ning Rongrong's words to heart. He just wants the results now.

First draw these people into the family system, and then slowly train them.

One day, he will convince everyone.

Even if some people are still unconvinced and not afraid, he doesn't care about the inheritance of the divine position.

He even had a premonition that it would not be easy to surrender to people like Tang San and Dai Mubai.

If you can't surrender, then you can only deal with them as enemies.

“Perhaps, after dealing with them badly, they will slowly choose to compromise and use them to his advantage.

“Huh, I’m not a manly man, so what’s wrong if I don’t fulfill my promise?”

"You want to kill me?"

"As long as I die, the entire Shrek Academy will be buried with you because of your actions."

Ning Rongrong couldn't say anything, and she didn't want to call her boss, so she acted like a dead pig who wasn't afraid of boiling water.

"Haha, since you don't fulfill your promise."

"Then don't blame me for being unkind and disciplining you for your parents."
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 12 Educate Ning Rongrong, brothers are just for cheating - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning, create a god-level family"
